Keep all ordinary finite positive open/close and finite-label rows thereafter, including newer stocks with missing252-session candidate values. Do not impose the earlier descriptive$5/ADV gates or drop rows for candidate NaNs.

No fabricated pre-registry breadth/trajectory, sector history or historic news. Missing baseline columns remain explicit and identically represented for every variant.
data_recommendation.comparison_label: Current model configurations and saved input schemas refitted on consistent research data. These are not replayed historical production predictions or measured live fills.

confirmed_baseline_timing_issue.proof: cluster_gap_timing_probe.json changes only current-day close-derived cluster source inputs while holding opens and prior closes fixed; all80 synthetic historical open-known gaps change.
confirmed_baseline_timing_issue.cause: structure.py builds current-day cluster membership from current close-derived return20/volatility20/RSI14, then computes that same day's peer opening gaps. dataset.py restores this gap unshifted. Live inference instead groups by yesterday's cluster_id.
confirmed_baseline_timing_issue.required_repair: Recompute historical peer gaps using the preceding common session's cluster assignments and current opens/prior closes, excluding self. Do not simply shift the gap (that would use yesterday's opening prices). Apply the identical repair to baseline and candidates, and add a current-HLC-invariance/live-parity test.

proposed_chronology.calendar_rule: Use observed source trading dates within each inclusive interval; record exact first/last dates and row hashes after construction. Each fitting window ends strictly before the first scored date.
proposed_chronology.selection_rule: Predeclare the comparator and tie-breaking before fits. Recommended conservative winner: positive paired Rank IC and top20 mean-return changes on both inner blocks; among qualifying variants choose highest mean top20 change, then Rank IC, then fewer new inputs and name. If none qualifies, retain baseline as selected algorithm and report all candidates.
proposed_chronology.refinement: One bounded inner-only refinement round: all continuous dip measurements without setup flags; and a compact variant retaining all four setup flags plus up to8 new continuous inputs selected by positive training-model gain. Gain selection is repeated using each fitting window only, never its test labels. Report the exact selected inputs per fold. Do not add arbitrary threshold searches after inspecting outer metrics.
proposed_chronology.outer_use: Freeze selection using only dates through2025-06-30, then evaluate outer blocks once. No tightening or winner changes using outer outcomes. These are chronological diagnostics, not pristine untouched market history: earlier descriptive studies already examined these dates.
proposed_chronology.initial_variants: Baseline; four predeclared dip families using the implementation's exact named columns; all families combined. A separate all-flags diagnostic may be registered before fits if the final feature grouping needs it; no ad hoc later variants.

fit_cost_bound_and_oof.scope: One predeclared recent outer block initially. Rank gets broader chronological testing; do not imply identical fold coverage or claim full Fit validation from one block.
fit_cost_bound_and_oof.source_projection: Project the raw source frame to saved132rawinputs plus ticker/date/label before SVM fitting. This prevents new dip inputs from silently changing the seven SVM estimators. Join their cached outputs and candidate inputs by immutable unique row index.
fit_cost_bound_and_oof.oof_construction: For the final252-session LightGBM training window before2026-07-01, create historical SVM outputs using the2025H2 and2026H1 blocks. Each block's SVMs fit only the preceding252 sessions; then fit the paired scoring SVMs on the final252 sessions through2026-06-30 and score the outer block. Assert every fitting date precedes every scored date. If the first training date falls just before2025H2, add the necessary earlier causal block or omit that warmup row from all Fit variants consistently; never fill it in-sample.
fit_cost_bound_and_oof.comparison: Fit the baseline139-column LightGBM and candidate LightGBMs on identical OOF-covered training rows; keep the same paired SVM outputs and raw source inputs across variants. Fit outer results are confirmation/descriptive comparisons, never feature selection.
fit_cost_bound_and_oof.production_limit: This specifically tests adding dip inputs to the LightGBM head while holding SVM source columns fixed. Ordinary future training would feed newly persisted unpruned inputs into SVMs too. That full-stack change requires separate confirmation or an explicitly paired artifact preserving frozen SVM inputs before activation.
fit_cost_bound_and_oof.runtime_evidence: Recent production runs take6193–8091seconds (~1.7–2.25hours) for the full Fit training path. The old stacked-search doc estimates35–45minutes perSVR fit. Do not silently substitute raw LightGBM or truncated-SVR settings to meet a short runtime.
fit_cost_bound_and_oof.checkpoints: Checkpoint each SVM block and fitted result under the new research directory with ordered row IDs, fit/score dates, feature lists, parameter/data/code hashes. Resume only exact matching contexts. Existing ResearchRun is an optional numeric-only NPZ/SQLite pattern, not a live model store.
